briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and xAI Grok-4 escalate multi-agent AGI race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 major models this month amid $12.4B quarterly funding. Multi-agent systems now dominate benchmarks while regulatory gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI o4 achieved 94% on MMLU-Pro; Anthropic Claude 4.1 and xAI Grok-4 followed within 72 hours. DeepSeek-V4 and Meta Llama-405B updates target long-horizon agent workflows.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA H200 shipments hit 1.2M units; Microsoft and Google each announced 50k-GPU clusters online this quarter in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent protocol standards emerge before the first autonomous AGI cluster reaches 100k agents?
